saySample.text: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with calloused knuckles returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 50s returns with water: +2 clean.

"Hey." A man, maybe 60s, with weathered hands settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 60s, with weathered hands.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 40s, with deep-set eyes is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
A person, maybe 40s, with a shaved head traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Tariq and Brunhilde lingered over the fire together.
Elif and Liam lingered over the fire together.
Mia and Brunhilde lingered over the fire together.
📓 Journal: the man in his 60s, with weathered hands taught the person in their 40s, with deep-set eyes Camp Cooking.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 the woman in her 50s says they want to survive, whatever it takes. But they keep doing the exact thing someone who wants something else would do — and going quiet when anyone notices.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A woman, maybe 50s).
Snow by morning. The air bites on the way in.
A man, maybe 60s, with weathered hands will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A woman, maybe 60s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 40s, with a shaved head shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
📋 A man, maybe 60s, with weathered hands — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Rosa," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Rosa." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Rosa).
"Mia," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Mia." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Mia).
"Liam," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Liam." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Liam).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes says. (Trust too low.)
📋 A woman, maybe 30s wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."

🌿 Rosa checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~7 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 Rosa hauls back 5 wood. The pile grows. (14 logs now.)
💧 Liam returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
A woman, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A man, maybe 50s, with calloused knuckles heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
Mia heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
Liam is stirring the pot slow, fishing out a bone to check the meat.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
